* '''Original''' ([[Local Trouble (V)]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 1 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “At the beginning of your battle phase, use 1 Force to initiate a battle between two Imperials and an opponent’s character present at same interior site. For remainder of turn, no other battles may occur here and opponent takes no battle damage here.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock1">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf#page=5 Virtual Block 1 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"), page 5, slip 63. * '''PC-E1''' ([[Local Trouble (V) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and still on 11 January 2013) spelled “initiate” as “initate” (typo kept as published). PC-E1 text: “At the beginning of your battle phase, use 1 Force to initate a battle between two Imperials and an opponent's character present at same interior site. For remainder of turn, no other battles may occur here and opponent takes no battle damage here.”<ref name="cl-1210_63">Players Committee website card list (VBlock1Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064706/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142851/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock1Type.html 2013-01-11] (Internet Archive)</ref> The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). The PC website card list was generated from the Players Committee's Holotable card data (research R7, 11 November 2026), so its wording follows that data; it is listed as a version because the PC published it.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Local Trouble (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB1-D-localtrouble-pre.gif]]), on the PC website by 25 February 2013 (server upload date)<ref name="pcimg-Virtual1-Dark">Players Committee card image, file <code>cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual1-Dark/large/localtrouble.gif</code>; the directory listing of this folder (Virtual1-Dark) was not captured; the captured Legacy folders (Virtual2, Virtual4, Virtual5, Virtual6, Virtual7) all carry 25-Feb-2013 11:33/11:34, the date the PC rebuilt its image set (research R6, 11 November 2026: these are bulk upload dates, and an image may have been made earlier). Today's copy: https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/legacy/VirtualBlock1-Dark/large/localtrouble.gif</ref>: “At the beginning of your battle phase, use 1 Force to initiate a battle between two Imperials and an opponent's character present at same interior site. For remainder of turn, no other battles may occur here and opponent takes no battle damage here.” '''What changed:''' the PC card image prints the original release-sheet text of 7 December 2009 again, word for word, after the PC website card list (PC-E1) had published a different text. It is listed as its own version, placed at its upload date (Bill's rulings of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is its own version, placed at its date (here its server upload date), even when its words repeat an earlier version; whatever was published last is current). The date is only the folder's bulk upload date: the image may have been made earlier, so its place in the order is uncertain, but the versioning order follows the upload date. Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and the Virtual Block 1 set mark) and prints the number “63” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
